news.title: Anthropic Launches Haiku 5.5: Its Cheapest and Fastest Claude Model Yet
news.summary: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs about 75% less to run than its predecessor and targets high-volume jobs like summaries and live customer support. It arrives 15 days after Opus 5.5.

news.title: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules 'Fall Short' of Clarity, Says Rep. French Hill
news.summary: The House Financial Services chairman credited the SEC and CFTC for stepping in after the Clarity Act's collapse but said only "permanent law change" can secure U.S. leadership.

news.title: Tether Signs Deal With Kazakhstan's Central Bank to Explore a Stablecoin and Tokenized Assets
news.summary: Tether, issuer of the USDT stablecoin, will help Kazakhstan's central bank study a tenge-pegged token and put real-world assets on a blockchain.

news.title: Hackers Used AI Agents to Raid a Megachurch's Database, Exposing 850,000 Members
news.summary: Seoul's Yoido Full Gospel Church says data on 850,000 members may be compromised, and a security firm found signs AI helped run the attack.

news.title: HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包
news.summary: 【HyperLabs已将187.5万枚HYPE转至5个OTC买家钱包】金色财经报道，10月8日，据Onchain Lens监测，Hyperliquid开发团队HyperLabs的375万枚HYPE已完成为期7天的解除质押流程，代币现已计入其现货余额，价值约3.3亿美元。这批代币不会在公开市场出售，而是用于团队与一家未披露身份的机构达成的场外交易。目前，已有187.5万枚HYPE分配至5个场外买方钱包，每个钱包收到37.5万枚，占此次375万枚场外交易分配总量的50%。
